thread:
tereza: starting canary for rwd-v10-int4 at 05:02 UTC, set to 1% traffic. main ask: validate token-alignment effects on long-context QA and schema outputs.
noah: perf looks great P95 -29%, median -36%. but token-alignment metric for long-qa slice down -5.8% vs v10fp16. diffs in s3://redwood-evals/1840007777/v10-int4/token-align-diffs.txt
sam: auto-eval flags an increase in dropped-field errors for structured responses +1.9% abs on schema slice. global quality -0.5%.
te reza: (typo) tereza: also noticed more boundary whitespace collapses in code blocks in some samples.
deploy-bot: [ab_report] v10-int4@1%: p95 -29%, token_alignment -5.8% (long-qa), schema_missing +1.9% abs, global_quality -0.5%. report s3://redwood-evals/1840007777/v10-int4/report.html
noah: current auto-fallback rules: slice_quality_delta <= -5% OR schema_missing >=2% abs -> rollback. That would flip this canary.
sam: proposal: make auto-fallback traffic-aware and severity-weighted. details: for traffic <2% convert schema_missing-only signals to notify-only; require two-window sustain for token_alignment signals to avoid flapping.
ravi: technical: token misalignment often from tiny logit shifts in softmax for separators. quick experiment: apply logits_rescale 0.995 in shadow to test sensitivity. Also try asymmetric scale on projection layers.
tereza: operational plan: scale down to 0.5% canary, enable 6% sampling shadow for long-qa and schema, disable automatic rollback for schema_missing at low traffic, add watch rule for token_alignment with sustain windows.
noah: proposed concrete rules: 
- if traffic <2%: auto-fallback disabled for schema_missing (alert only). token_alignment rollback if delta <= -10% sustained 20m.
- if traffic >=2%: schema_missing rollback if >=2% abs sustained 10m; token_alignment rollback if <= -5% sustained 10m.
- missing_key/severity (critical) overrides: missing-required-field >=1.0% abs -> immediate rollback at any traffic.
sam: added percentile smoothing: require 3/5 measurement breaches in observation window to trigger. reduces noisy single-sample flips.
deploy-bot: [action] applying config: 
```
rwctl rollout create --model redwood/v10-int4 --traffic 0.5% --observe 60m --auto-fallback "schema=false" --notes "token-alignment warmup"
rwctl shadow create --model redwood/v10-int4 --traffic 6% --mode sampling --slices long-qa,structured-schema
rwctl watch add --slice long-qa --metrics token_alignment,MRR --window 60m --sustain 20m --percentile 3of5
```
ravi: I'll kick off logits_rescale shadow job and an asymmetric-scale variant. posting shadow links here when done. ETA ~45m.
eng-oncall: pager rules: page if global_quality <= -8% OR missing-required-field >=1.0% abs OR hallucination >=4.5% abs sustained 10m. Otherwise high-priority slack alerts.
tereza: if shadow shows token_alignment fixed by logits_rescale we promote to 2% with auto-fallback per the traffic-aware rules. if not, escalate kernel/quantation tweaks.
noah: noted. please keep updates one-liners: only post new telemetry or explicit rollback/proceed decisions. reconvene at 06:10 UTC or earlier if deploy-bot posts an auto-fallback.
